goal: Implement native new-session and templates flow with built-in templates, custom profile creation, preset JSON validation, and a safe source-import handoff.
non_goals: Do not implement chat timeline, composer, quote, or message actions; those belong to NATIVE-P2-003.
Do not implement full import/export protocol payloads; those belong to Phase 4.
Do not implement local source file parsing or file picker; those belong to NATIVE-P5-005.
Do not store API keys or provider secrets in session presets.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions screen exposes a native New session entry.
User can create a session from built-in templates for school, exam, work, language, habit, and skill learning.
User can create a custom session with title, role, goal, and profile/personality text.
Created sessions persist through Room-backed repository behavior and appear in the session list.
Profile data is persisted in existing session settings without changing Room schema version 1.
Preset JSON is validated before use and rejects secret/key material.
Preset JSON can create a session after validation.
Initial source selection is represented as a safe deferred handoff to the sources module, not silent file loss.
Automated tests cover built-in templates, custom profile validation/persistence, and preset validation.
Legacy coverage registry is updated conservatively for LEG-008, LEG-009, LEG-010, LEG-011, and LEG-043.
verification_expectations: Follow TDD: add failing tests before production implementation for templates, preset validation, and session creation persistence.
Run focused core protocol, core data, feature chat, and app JVM tests.
Run connected core data instrumentation if an ADB device is available.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture new-session/template/custom/preset smoke evidence when feasible.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json.
notes: Existing PRD/ARCH/TODO and prior user approval are the design basis for this task.
Use existing Room schema v1 where possible; avoid schema changes unless tests prove they are necessary.
Preset validation in this task is a safe preview contract; full export/import schemas remain Phase 4 work.
